demos.title: Token hook: recipient allowlist on a wrapped token
demos.enforcement: Native for the wrapped Token-2022 mint: every transfer_checked runs the stack. The original SPL token is unaffected; holders opt in by wrapping.

install allowlist(recipient = bob) on the wrapped mint

demos.title: Transaction hook: maximum trade size on routed PumpSwap buys
demos.enforcement: Router: applies only to trades sent through hook-router. PumpSwap has no native hooks and stays directly callable, as the last step shows.
setup: load PumpSwap (devnet binaries) and the cloned devnet pool 9Nhddo1PcCBms54wcLYbxoRcAJbpmSvHWMcbdMf9tdmZ
initialize hook-router; enable the PumpSwap venue
create a shared route policy: max-size 1 SOL on before_swap (mandatory)

demos.title: Account hook: timelock + daily spending limit
demos.enforcement: Program: every withdrawal from the smart account's vault runs its stack. Mandatory entries can only be changed through an aged proposal.
